exact_predecessor_frontier: Test one cross-invocation predecessor-closure mechanism: predecessor e2 precommits a proposal deadline/slot; successors remain proposals; a later invocation may authorize only after closure and only if every admissible predecessor-bound certificate is equivalent; stress a conflicting writer before versus after the precommitted boundary.
planned_atomic_boundary: One finite symbolic admission-barrier probe with no external side effect: compare before-boundary and after-boundary conflicting proposals, classify what authority is required for closure, then persist exact scope, blocker/revision, and nonempty continuation.
